items.q: Did you work with Janet Collins long. Just for that show.

ctx.x: There were no women in the WPA.

Only like those that could -- they had a few singers, like choirs and maybe seamstress and things like that, so when they wanted to do their show, they had to take all the girls that could dance and put them into the WPA. And they only got just one salary, everybody, which was 94-something a month. You know, they paid off by the month at that time.
